races.name: Track Radio On Digital & DAB Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Look Back Smiling
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning after 61 days off, needs strong pace and clear run but potentially well handicapped after stable switch
runners_data.comment: After changing hands for 9,000gns he was out the back on stable debut at Bath
runners_data.spotlight: Lost his way last autumn and, after changing hands for 9,000gns, he was out the back on stable debut at Bath (1m, good; fine on soft); potentially well handicapped but has enough to prove.

runners_data.name: Platinum Prince
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer who won this race last year off similar mark, trainer out of form but horse handles conditions
runners_data.comment: Seven career wins include this race 12 months ago off only 3lb lower
runners_data.spotlight: Needs a revival but fast ground wasn't ideal on his comeback run and seven career wins include this race 12 months ago off only 3lb lower; rarely looks straightforward but remains capable of winning races.

runners_data.name: Bizou
runners_data.note: Prominent racer in good form with two recent wins, only 2lb higher and versatile tactically
runners_data.comment: Improving hat-trick seeker but slow ground hasn't looked ideal previously
runners_data.spotlight: Improved to win at Windsor (1m2f, good to firm) and followed up from the front at Wolverhampton (9.4f), albeit by the skin of her teeth; only 2lb higher so remains on a competitive mark, but slow ground hasn't looked ideal previously.

runners_data.name: Perfect Scoundrel
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who has been well beaten in recent handicaps, hard to recommend despite consistent placing
runners_data.comment: Beaten between 6.5l and 11l in his three handicaps (1m2f-1m4f) and has only dropped 5lb
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten between 6.5l and 11l in his three handicaps (1m2f-1m4f) and has only dropped 5lb; doesn't look a winner waiting to happen.

runners_data.name: Oman
runners_data.note: Versatile hold-up performer who was close-up last time, experienced apprentice takes useful weight off
runners_data.comment: Versatile ground-wise and he wasn't far off the principals last time at Lingfield
runners_data.spotlight: Versatile ground-wise and he wasn't far off the principals last time at Lingfield (1m2f); hard to call him well handicapped but entitled to have some say.

runners_data.name: Tilani
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with two recent wins for in-form Ian Williams, proven at this trip on good ground
runners_data.comment: Had no penalty last time and now 6lb higher, but he's on a roll; has won on soft
runners_data.spotlight: Ex-Irish gelding who has only had four runs for Ian Williams and won the last two, 1m handicaps on good ground at Newbury and Yarmouth; had no penalty last time and now 6lb higher, but he's on a roll; has won on soft.

runners_data.name: Pay Attention
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse wearing first-time headgear combination, better off at weights with Tilani from recent Newbury run
runners_data.comment: Chance on his Newbury run last time but softening ground might not be favourable
runners_data.spotlight: Missed the break at Newbury (1m, good; in this first-time headgear combination) but still got to challenge Tilani and he's better off at the weights with that rival here; has missed three engagements in the last year on account of good to soft and soft ground.

runners_data.name: Somkiyr
runners_data.note: Only confirmed front runner, modest recent form but tactical advantage could prove crucial
runners_data.comment: Modest hurdler and hasn't been finding life all that easier back on the Flat
runners_data.spotlight: Won in France at two; modest hurdler for current team and hasn't been finding life all that easier back on the Flat.

runners_data.name: Trooper
runners_data.note: Hold-up performer returning after 405 days off, wellbeing major concern despite previous European form
runners_data.comment: Current wellbeing is an issue but goes well with ease underfoot and cheekpieces go on
runners_data.spotlight: Five-time Flat winner in Belgium/Germany and could be glad to see the back of hurdles having offered nothing in that scene; current wellbeing is an issue but goes well with ease underfoot and cheekpieces go on; he'd be interesting if market vibes did bode well.

races.paceDynamic: Somkiyr appears the only confirmed front runner in this field, likely to set a sustainable pace without early pressure. Bizou and Tilani can race prominently if needed, but both are versatile enough to track. The majority of this field consists of hold-up horses including Look Back Smiling, Platinum Prince, Perfect Scoundrel, Oman, Pay Attention and Trooper, creating a patient tactical setup. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers and early leaders who can avoid the inevitable traffic problems that will develop in the straight when multiple hold-up horses come looking for racing room.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Lead Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If Somkiyr gets an easy lead with minimal early pace pressure from Bizou or Tilani
scenarios.body: The pace becomes very manageable allowing the leader to kick clear in the straight before the hold-up brigade can organize their challenges. This tactical advantage proves decisive in a race where most horses need luck in running.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Bizou or Tilani push forward early to challenge Somkiyr for the early initiative
scenarios.body: A genuine pace develops that stretches the field and creates opportunities for strong finishers with tactical speed. The hold-up horses get a better tempo to aim at but still face traffic issues.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the two-furlong pole
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure test of who can quickest find daylight and produce the strongest finish. Weight advantages become crucial in a bunched finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Somkiyr fails to go forward or gets headed before halfway by multiple rivals
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with no clear pace angle, leading to a scrambling finish where positioning and luck matter more than class. Apprentice allowances prove decisive.

watchPoints.text: Somkiyr must be monitored early - if he fails to take up the running, the pace scenario changes completely
Pay Attention's break from stalls given he missed it badly last time when trying the headgear combination
Traffic problems developing in straight as multiple hold-up horses converge - watch for who gets first run
Bizou's positioning early will indicate if she's going to press Somkiyr or sit more patiently
Trooper's early enthusiasm after such a long absence will reveal current wellbeing quickly

races.name: Fitzdares Apprentice Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (Horses In Bands B-D)

runners_data.name: Poddle Park
runners_data.note: Lightly raced newcomer to Britain whose running style remains unclear but breeding suggests middle-distance capability
runners_data.spotlight: 33,000gns yearling; seventh foal; half-sister to four winners including Valpolicella (6f; RPR 83), Grand Cru Gaga (6f; 74) and Adelabella (1m; 71); dam unraced half-sister to Listed-placed 6f winner Chocoya; faces no easy starter.

runners_data.name: Matilda Joslyngage
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist who has been competitive in Irish maidens but trainer struggling for winners recently
runners_data.comment: Bit to prove on this slower ground but her form claims are right up there
runners_data.spotlight: Competitive in her last two maidens in Ireland, over 1m on good to yielding and good ground; taken out of two other races due to soft and yielding conditions, which is a bit of a concern; however, her form claims are right up there.

runners_data.name: Miss Guinevere
runners_data.note: Unknown running style after one poor debut, has been off for 72 days and trainer form concerning
runners_data.comment: Made a quiet start when ninth at Kempton (1m; 20-1) and she was weak in the market
runners_data.spotlight: Daughter of Camelot who cost 65,000euros as a yearling; made a quiet start when ninth at Kempton (1m; 20-1) and she was weak in the market; the hood fitted there is removed.

runners_data.name: Afraj
runners_data.note: Natural hold-up horse who won narrowly last time but faces penalty after 191-day break
runners_data.comment: Penalised for winning a weak 7f maiden at Chelmsford but her inexperience was evident
runners_data.spotlight: Penalised for winning a weak 7f maiden at Chelmsford in November but she defied market weakness with a narrow verdict and her inexperience was evident; certainly open to further improvement.

runners_data.name: Venetian Gold
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up type who improved markedly to win last month and looks progressive for top connections
runners_data.comment: She was more with it when running out a length winner at Kempton last month
runners_data.spotlight: 62,000gns breeze-up buy by St Mark's Basilica; did a lot wrong on her debut and was more with it when running out a length winner at Kempton last month; has to go well in this company even with her extra weight.

runners_data.name: Living In Hope
runners_data.note: Confirmed hold-up runner but has been well beaten in both starts and may lack ability
runners_data.comment: Has brought up the rear in both her 1m races on the AW and looks one for handicaps
runners_data.spotlight: Has brought up the rear in both her 1m races on the AW and looks one for handicaps.

runners_data.name: Blue Birdie
runners_data.note: Another hold-up horse who fades badly in the finish and ran just 9 days ago
runners_data.comment: Tailed off in two visits to Kempton for 1m3f novice races
runners_data.spotlight: Tailed off in two visits to Kempton for 1m3f novice races.

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runner in this seven-horse field, expect a cagey affair where horses drift into the race gradually. Poddle Park or Miss Guinevere may reluctantly take them along at a modest tempo, but neither has shown clear early pace preferences. The lack of natural speed will create a bunched field turning for home, setting up a sprint finish from the furlong pole. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish, disadvantaging any that need to be handy or require a strong gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Crawling Pace Sprint
scenarios.trigger: If no horse commits to making the running early and they go a pedestrian gallop
scenarios.body: The field will bunch up approaching the home turn before exploding into a furious sprint finish. Hold-up specialists with tactical speed will thrive in this scenario while those needing a true gallop will struggle.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modest But Honest Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If Poddle Park or Miss Guinevere takes responsibility and maintains a reasonable rhythm
scenarios.body: The pace will be fair enough to create some stringing out in the home straight. This suits horses that can track the pace and quicken rather than pure closers needing a cavalry charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Complete Lottery Finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses entirely and they virtually walk the first half-mile
scenarios.body: It becomes a complete luck-in-running scenario where position and room matter more than ability. Any horse getting a clear run could win regardless of form or rating.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Breakaway Succeeds
scenarios.trigger: If one runner breaks clear early and the field fails to respond adequately
scenarios.body: The leader could steal a march and prove hard to peg back on the testing ground. This would suit any horse brave enough to make their own running from the outset.

watchPoints.text: Venetian Gold could dominate if producing the same finishing kick that won at Kempton last month
Afraj carries a penalty after a long break which may blunt her effectiveness in a competitive finish
Poddle Park's running style remains a mystery but any market support would be significant given her pedigree
Miss Guinevere has been fitted with a hood after a poor debut and needs to show much more
The soft ground may play into the hands of the hold-up horses who can use it as cover for their finishing kicks

races.name: Tommie Jakes Memorial Apprentice Fillies' Handicap

runners_data.name: Twirler
runners_data.note: Hold-up runner who overcame trouble at Windsor but faces limited pace angles with most field wanting to be prominent
runners_data.comment: Did well to overcome trouble in running at Windsor a month ago; won on good to soft
runners_data.spotlight: Exposed six-time winner who did well to overcome trouble in running at Windsor one month ago (6f, good to firm; 4lb lower); unraced here but she's an Epsom winner on good to soft.

runners_data.name: Thunderous Love
runners_data.note: Prominent runner from low draw who should get easy lead, back on last winning mark after 7f failure
runners_data.comment: Back on her last winning mark and perhaps stretched by 7f last time; ground fine
runners_data.spotlight: Back on her last winning mark and perhaps stretched by 7f last time when behind Land Of Magic; fine on all surfaces and considered, despite a low draw.

runners_data.name: Insuspense
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with consistent maiden form but questionable on slower ground despite headgear applied
runners_data.comment: She's a consistent maiden but whether she wants slowish ground is questionable
runners_data.spotlight: Forced to challenge widest of all last time at Windsor so forget that; she's a consistent maiden but whether she wants slowish ground is questionable (withdrawn the once on account of such conditions).

runners_data.name: Moostar
runners_data.note: Prominent runner with nursery form on good-to-soft, consistent rather than progressive but well-positioned tactically
runners_data.comment: Has been running well in defeat, though her form in cheekpieces is poor
runners_data.spotlight: Nursery winner over 6f on good to soft; more consistent than progressive in her recent defeats and mark continues to edge upwards; should still run well, provided the return of cheekpieces (replacing visor) doesn't trouble her as they've done nothing in the past.

runners_data.name: Addarella
runners_data.note: Prominent runner whose best form came on all-weather, struggling since yard switch and ground conditions uncertain
runners_data.comment: Good first run for this yard back at Wolverhampton but hasn't kicked on at all
runners_data.spotlight: Both wins over this trip but on the AW and for Marco Botti; it was a good first run for this yard back at Wolverhampton but hasn't kicked on at all; ground conditions are another likely negative, together with stall 1.

runners_data.name: Land Of Magic
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who front-ran to recent second at Lingfield, dropping back to 6f suits tactical approach
runners_data.comment: Strike-rate of 4-35; best run for a while when a front-running second at Lingfield
runners_data.spotlight: Strike-rate of 4-35; best run for a while when a front-running second at Lingfield (7f, good) and dropping back to 6f won't hinder, nor the slower ground; could have done with a higher draw ideally but should run well.

runners_data.name: Rye
runners_data.note: Prominent runner drawn well but longstanding maiden with limited experience on ground slower than good
runners_data.comment: Consistent and well drawn but might not be helped by good to soft ground
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden but hard to knock her consistency and she's handily drawn in ten; however, only once has she encountered ground slower than good and she trailed home last.

runners_data.name: Midnight Call
runners_data.note: Prominent runner fresh from front-running AW wins but making turf debut for current connections
runners_data.comment: Dictated from the front last time to make it 6-14 on the AW; unraced on slow turf
runners_data.spotlight: Has won two of her last three on the AW, taking overall record on synthetics to 6-14; last time she dictated from the front at Wolverhampton (4lb lower); seemed to handle turf fine in three previous attempts, though not on ground this slow.

runners_data.name: Magna
runners_data.note: Prominent runner on excellent AW form but complete turf inexperience poses significant question mark
runners_data.comment: Improver on the AW but she has no worthwhile form on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Has been on a roll on the AW and wasn't far away behind Midnight Call in her bid for a four-timer (fine at 5f and 6f); the glaring concern is that she has no worthwhile form on turf, albeit after just four attempts.

runners_data.name: Cameley Days
runners_data.note: Prominent runner who won three of last six but faces another career-high mark after 3lb rise
runners_data.comment: In-form filly and latest defeat no backward step; has won over 6f on good to soft
runners_data.spotlight: Has won three of her last six races and the defeat at Lingfield 17 days ago was no backward step (5f, good); has another career high mark to deal with (raised 3lb) but she's a 6f winner on good to soft and very much considered from stall 8.

races.paceDynamic: Thunderous Love will likely lead from her low draw with several prominent runners including Moostar, Land Of Magic, Midnight Call, and Magna ensuring a competitive pace. The substantial group of front-runners and prominent racers will create genuine early pressure over this sharp 6f trip at Goodwood. With most runners having prominent or pace-setting tendencies and only Twirler and Insuspense as genuine hold-up horses, the pace will be testing from the start. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can position handily and kick from close range, as pure front-runners may pay for early exertions and hold-up horses face too few pace angles to exploit.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is strong but sustainable with multiple front-runners engaging
scenarios.body: The testing early fractions will set up perfectly for horses positioned in second or third who can strike approaching the final furlong. Prominent runners avoid both the early speed battle and the traffic issues that hold-up horses will encounter.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire To Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Thunderous Love or Midnight Call establishes a clear early lead without immediate pressure
scenarios.body: The leader gets an easy time in front before the field closes, allowing them to maintain enough energy for the final kick. Recent front-running success from both Land Of Magic and Midnight Call supports this outcome.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold Up Horse Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early with front-runners going too conservatively
scenarios.body: A slow early pace turns the race into a sprint finish where late-running horses can unleash one devastating run. Twirler's Windsor win and Insuspense's consistent placings give them the class edge in a tactical finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Speed Battle Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If multiple front-runners engage in a fierce early battle through aggressive riding
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainably fast with leaders tying up badly in the final furlong, allowing mid-pack horses to pick up the pieces. Tony Carroll's three runners could benefit if positioned just behind the early speed.

watchPoints.text: Magna and Midnight Call are unproven on turf despite excellent recent all-weather form
Thunderous Love could get uncontested lead from low draw if other front-runners hesitate early
Twirler needs genuine pace pressure to set up her hold-up style but most runners want to be handy
Insuspense has been withdrawn once before for ground concerns and may struggle on good-to-soft
Tony Carroll fields three runners with different tactical profiles providing multiple race-winning angles

races.name: Join Fitzdares For A Personal Betting Service Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Perfect Location
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who has shown good form at 7f and should appreciate the likely strong pace from her handy position
runners_data.comment: Can win races off this mark but didn't convince when upped to 7f last time
runners_data.spotlight: 6f maiden winner on the AW and runner-up off this mark on her handicap debut next time (6f, good to soft); again runner-up at Kempton two runs ago but over 6f and didn't convince when upped to 7f latest.

runners_data.name: Miss Lady Grace
runners_data.note: Front runner whose best form came when dominating from the front, but needs to handle the challenge from Ice Cube early
runners_data.spotlight: Her fifth start when winning a 7f maiden from the front at Wolverhampton in February; out the back in 6f/7f handicaps since then.

runners_data.name: Ahead Of Fashion
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose recent second at Wolverhampton came in a weak field, making that form unconvincing
runners_data.comment: Only four ran when second at Wolverhampton last time (7f) and that form is unconvincing
runners_data.spotlight: Placed a few times, though only four ran when second at Wolverhampton last time (7f) and that form is unconvincing; others preferred.

runners_data.name: Twilight Glow
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse whose best effort remains his second on good to soft ground, perfectly suited to strong pace scenarios
runners_data.comment: Best run was on good to soft; this is easier than a Class 4 at Ascot last time
runners_data.spotlight: His second on good to soft at Newbury last season (6f maiden) remains his best piece of form; gelded prior to this campaign and ran okay on his return (7f handicap) before struggling in a Class 4 over 6f at Ascot; one to consider in these calmer waters.

runners_data.name: Feisty Minx
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse who showed promise on handicap debut and may benefit from the step back in trip
runners_data.comment: Close up over 7f on handicap debut and 1m seemed too far last time; first run on turf
runners_data.spotlight: Beaten just over a length into fourth of seven on handicap debut at Kempton (7f) and 1m seemed too far back there 16 days ago; not yet exposed, though this is her first time on the grass.

runners_data.name: Chelio
runners_data.note: Prominent racer who showed promise last season but has been well held in handicaps this campaign despite market support
runners_data.comment: Short in the betting for both handicaps and Windsor last time didn't go to plan
runners_data.spotlight: Promising runs last season at 7f/1m; well held in two handicaps (7f/6f) this campaign, though was quite short in the betting for both and Windsor last time didn't go to plan; wouldn't rule out.

runners_data.name: Ice Cube
runners_data.note: Front runner who has been favoured in the betting recently but weakened over longer trips, should benefit from 7f drop
runners_data.comment: Has shown plenty of pace in 1m handicaps and dropping back to 7f should help
runners_data.spotlight: Only 5-4 and 4-1 for his two 1m handicaps since being gelded and showed plenty of pace both times before weakening; dropping back in trip should be a big help.

runners_data.name: Fanjove
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse and dual AW handicap winner who disappointed last time but could bounce back on turf
runners_data.comment: The winner of two 7f handicaps on the AW and has shown he can threaten off this mark
runners_data.spotlight: The winner of two 7f handicaps on the AW and has shown he can threaten off this mark; last run was disappointing but could bounce back, and no doubt a better horse now than when last seen on turf.

runners_data.name: Irish Fusilier
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse returning from 220-day break who should benefit from the step up in trip from his juvenile campaigns
runners_data.comment: Made some progress in each of his runs last season (5f/6f); handicap debut
runners_data.spotlight: Made some progress in each of his runs last season (5f/6f) and was always likely to be seen to better effect once entering handicaps; this step up in trip should be a further plus; the market could be revealing after a lengthy break.

races.paceDynamic: Miss Lady Grace and Ice Cube will force the early pace, with both confirmed front runners likely to engage from the start over this 7f trip. Miss Lady Grace showed her best form when winning from the front at Wolverhampton, while Ice Cube has displayed plenty early pace in his recent starts before weakening at longer distances. The honest gallop these two create should set up the race perfectly for those with finishing kicks. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can benefit from the strong pace and time their challenges late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Early Pace
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Lady Grace and Ice Cube go hard early and create genuine speed
scenarios.body: The strong gallop will find out the front runners in the final furlong, setting up perfect conditions for closers to finish strongly. Hold-up horses with proven finishing kicks will have ideal conditions to strike.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Moderate Honest Gallop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace setters go at a sensible clip without overdoing it early
scenarios.body: The race will develop into a fair test where prominent racers can take advantage of good position without the leaders completely stopping. Those handy to the pace with tactical speed will benefit most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Miss Lady Grace and Ice Cube go too fast and both fade dramatically
scenarios.body: The lack of sustained pace will favour those who can quicken from any position, turning it into more of a sprint finish. Horses with natural pace regardless of style will have the edge.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If both front runners are restrained creating a slowly-run race
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace will turn this into a dash from the 3f pole where natural speed matters most. Those with gate speed who can also finish will dominate this scenario.

watchPoints.text: Miss Lady Grace and Ice Cube will determine the entire race complexion - if they go too fast early both could fade dramatically
Perfect Location's early position will be crucial as she needs to avoid getting trapped behind the pace battle
Twilight Glow's finishing kick will be key to watch as he has the profile to benefit most from a strong gallop
Fanjove's return to turf after disappointing on AW last time could spark a significant bounce back
Irish Fusilier's fitness after 220 days off will be evident in how he travels through the early stages

races.name: Thelma Horne Memorial Apprentice Handicap

runners_data.name: Jakarta

runners_data.name: Asteverdi
runners_data.note: Strong hold-up horse with excellent soft ground form who should benefit from the likely modest early tempo

runners_data.name: City Of God
runners_data.note: Natural front-runner but moderate recent form suggests he may struggle to resist late challengers despite tactical advantage

runners_data.name: Silca Bay
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making soft ground debut with cheekpieces restored after encouraging Salisbury fourth

runners_data.spotlight: All three wins on the AW and ground this slow will be a first for him; however, his usual cheekpieces are back on after keeping on well for fourth at Salisbury (1m, good) and he enters the equation.

runners_data.name: Cristo

runners_data.spotlight: Both wins have been at Chelmsford over 1m2f; capable of winning on turf and had Silca Bay behind when going close at Salisbury last time (1m, good; effective on soft); more solid than most in here.

runners_data.name: Rising Force
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with solid recent win on good to soft but may be feeling the effects of his current rating

runners_data.name: Ararat
runners_data.note: Prominent runner stepping up to 1m for the first time whose front-running style could create tempo issues

runners_data.name: Port Erin
runners_data.note: Prominent performer with previous good to soft form but recent poor runs create significant doubt

runners_data.spotlight: Won three 1m handicaps (AW/good) last year and was fourth in an earlier race on this card 12 months ago when the ground was good to soft; the clear negative is complete no-shows in his last three starts.

runners_data.name: Canopus
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse with minimal worthwhile form for current connections and appears outclassed at this level

runners_data.spotlight: A 1m maiden winner for Ed Walker; no worthwhile form over hurdles or on the Flat (two handicaps) for this operation.

races.paceDynamic: City Of God will attempt to lead with Ararat and Port Erin tracking close behind, but none are natural speed merchants which creates a modest early gallop. The bulk of the field (Jakarta, Asteverdi, Silca Bay, Cristo, Rising Force, Canopus) will settle in behind this gentle tempo. With limited early pressure, the pace will only quicken from the 3f pole when the prominent runners engage and the hold-up horses make their moves. This tactical setup strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late charges, as they'll benefit from the lack of early burn and have fresher legs for the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace stays modest with City Of God untroubled through halfway
scenarios.body: The gentle tempo will allow hold-up performers to conserve energy before unleashing telling late kicks. Asteverdi and Cristo have the class to capitalise on this tactical advantage with their proven finishing ability.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Strike
scenarios.trigger: If Port Erin or Ararat press City Of God early creating a stronger gallop
scenarios.body: The increased tempo will stretch the field and favour those positioned handy who can respond without needing room. Port Erin's stamina and Ararat's front-running tendencies could prove decisive in a more honestly-run contest.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Class Prevails Late
scenarios.trigger: If the race becomes a pure sprint finish with multiple horses in contention at the furlong pole
scenarios.body: Superior class ratings and proven finishing kicks will separate the contenders in a bunched finale. Cristo and Rising Force possess the necessary quality to outgun their rivals when it matters most.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If City Of God builds an unassailable lead through lacklustre fractions
scenarios.body: The front-runner will have stolen crucial lengths while others were content to wait. Despite his moderate recent form, City Of God could exploit tactical naivety behind him to score at rewarding odds.

races.paceDynamic: Sixpack is the clear pace angle and will likely take them along at a steady gallop, with Love Is Golden and Renesmee tracking close behind in the prominent positions. Dancing Tiger and Must Believe will also be handy early, creating a genuine pace but nothing frantic over this stamina test. The early positions will be contested but not at breakneck speed, allowing the race to develop into a proper staying test from the home turn. This sustainable pace strongly favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed to position well, as the leaders will not collapse and hold-up horses will struggle to make up significant ground on soft ground over this trip.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sixpack Controls Tempo
scenarios.trigger: If Sixpack gets an uncontested lead and dictates fractions...
scenarios.body: He can kick for home turning in and prove hard to peg back, with other prominent racers ideally placed to follow through. The soft ground aids his stamina and those who can travel into contention without effort.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Battle Develops
scenarios.trigger: If Love Is Golden and Dancing Tiger press Sixpack from early...
scenarios.body: The pace lifts sufficiently to set up a genuine staying test where class and stamina tell in the final furlong. Progressive types with proven stamina over similar trips can capitalize.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is genuinely crawling and bunches the field...
scenarios.body: Salamanca City or Adjuvant can use their class to quicken past tiring leaders in a sprint finish. This requires the prominent horses to go too slow early then collapse late.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Package Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the market principals fail to fire on the soft ground...
scenarios.body: Arthur's Realm or Tiger can outrun expectations if finding their best form after recent struggles. The conditions could unlock improvement from horses whose recent form doesn't reflect their true ability.
